summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, a new flagship model claiming state-of-the-art performance on multiple coding and knowledge-work benchmarks at the same API price as its predecessor Opus 4.8.

mechanisms.reason: The model is presented as new state-of-the-art on several coding and knowledge-work benchmarks and shows large jumps on novel-problem and long-horizon agentic tasks.
mechanisms.quote: On coding and knowledge work evaluations like Frontier-Bench and GDPval-AA , Opus 5 is the new state-of-the-art

mechanisms.reason: The model delivers substantially higher performance at the same per-token price as its predecessor, improving the performance-per-dollar of inference.
mechanisms.quote: Claude Opus 5 provides greatly improved performance for the same cost as its predecessor, Opus 4.8.

mechanisms.reason: The release emphasizes long-running, multi-step, tool-using agentic behavior across coding, research, and business-automation use cases, per multiple customer testimonials.
mechanisms.quote: Claude Opus 5 is a strong agentic coding model built for long-running, multi-step work.

notable_reason: This is a flagship frontier model launch with claimed state-of-the-art benchmark results and price-performance improvements, relevant to tracking model-layer competitive dynamics and inference economics.
